why: One source, scan depth: the floor. It prices the fixed cost of a turn that reads a single page — system prompt, tool schemas and one fetch's tool result — and it is the control the bigger jobs are read against. The check is a fact only that page carries (its founding year and its county), so a run that answers from the model's own memory instead of reading fails. The path is PINNED: one source, one fetch, so this is the job whose band is tight enough to gate on.
